about_the_game:
Demo

In this demo, you will take on the role of Vivian, a hunter dedicated to safeguarding her dark elf heritage. You begin the demonstration with a classic metroidvania move set with the abilities to double-jump and directional-dash immediately. You will be able to find and buy weapons, spells, and potions all in a tightly contained area. This should be roughly a 30 minute experience that is representative of a much larger, open game world. The demos story and environments will differ from the actual game.

Game

MegaQuest is a unique blend of various gaming elements, combining the rendering and movement styles reminiscent of titles like Metroid Dread and Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown, infused with roguelite mechanics akin to Dead Cells. The gameplay pays tribute to classic Castlevania-inspired games, such as Bloodstained, all set within a richly crafted fantasy realm inhabited by dark elves.

content_descriptors.notes: There is animated fantasy violence in this game. There is violent combat with weapons and magic. Animated blood is often used.
